_source: Home-page hero. Read directly by HomeController (JsonFileProvider, same pattern as HistoryController/FranchiseController - no Repository layer, this is a single content record with no swap-source scenario yet) and rendered through components/hero/hero.php as the vintage editorial hero stage. 'slides[].media.src'/'mobile_src'/'poster' may be a full URL (used as-is) or a theme-relative path (e.g. 'assets/images/...') - HomeController prefixes any non-http path with VINTAGESOUL_URI, same rule FranchiseController already applies to its own hero image. All three slides here use 'type: image' - the theme's only local video asset (assets/videos/hero_bg.mp4) turned out to be unrelated mascot/character animation content, not a usable ambient background clip, so it was swapped back out; components/hero/hero.php and its CSS/JS still fully support a video slide (type: video, plus mobile_src/poster) for whenever a real background-video asset exists - see pages/elements/view.php's own Hero demo, which still uses one, for a working reference. The photo is edge-to-edge (no side gutter at md+), so 'slides[].cards[].position' values here are small POSITIVE insets - the card sits as a small paper badge just inside the photo's own edge, not floating outside it in margin space that no longer exists. It's still a free {top|bottom, left|right} percentage pair, not a fixed 'top-left'/'bottom-right' keyword - components/hero/hero.php's own docblock explains how that pair also drives which direction the card animates in from. 'connector' is off on every card here since a connector line pointing from a card toward the photo doesn't read sensibly once the card already sits on the photo - the component still supports it for a future slide whose cards float outside the media instead.
